title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
Alien Disclosure
Are governments around the world preparing mankind for the most startling event in human history--the official disclosure of extraterrestrial contact? Or even an extraterrestrial presence on Earth right now? And if so, why is this happening now, what form might the announcement take, and what might happen in its aftermath?

title: Top Secret UFO Projects: Declassified
description:
Project Blue Book Unknown
Interest in the UFO phenomenon has been on the rise since World War II. And so, Project Blue Book comes into being – a project aimed at gathering and analyzing UFO observations. To this day, many cases still raise unanswered questions. The flight of UFOs over Washington in 1952. A turnaround in the attitude of the project’s chief scientific advisor, Joseph A. Hynek, regarding UFOs. The flight of an unidentified vessel with a humanoid crew over the Boianai mission in Papua New Guinea in 1959. Professor Hynek was not the only one interested in what police officer Lonnie Zamora witnessed in New Mexico in 1964 and what Eddie Laxson witnessed in Texas two years later. Project Blue Book still has many secrets to reveal….

title: Top Secret UFO Projects: Declassified
description:
The White House Cover-Up
What's the truth and what's mere disinformation in the so far unraveled history of the organization known as the MJ-12? Was MJ-12 the true controlling agency of the US government, and could it still be so? Was its establishment related to the mysterious events over Roswell? And if MJ-12 still exists and was merely transformed, who are its members? It is still unclear whether it's a select elite group of experts or if even the US president is its member. Which of the post-war presidents knew more about Top Secret UFO Projects than the others? And what role did the testimonies of Travis Walton or Terry Lovelace, both allegedly abducted onto alien crafts, play? A close cooperation between the government and private subjects has proven extremely successful at keeping secrets over the years.

title: Top Secret UFO Projects: Declassified
description:
Code Name Aurora
One of the most important entries in the history of reverse engineering was the testimony by colonel Phillip J. Corsa regarding what he witnessed at the Fort Riley military base the day after the Roswell incident. According to Corso, the army possesses at last one crashed extraterrestrial craft. How much would this advance top secret reverse engineering programs? What secrets are to be found behind the veil of the mysterious Project Aurora? To what extent have we been able to master technologies recovered from alien vehicles? One of the people working on the recovered extraterrestrial aircraft was the physicist Bob Lazar. His description of the disc as well as the mission parameters are to this day very consistent and detailed. Moreover, they also match more recent findings and published information. Army videos from 2017 display aircraft with incredible flight capabilities. Is the revelation of the truth behind UFOs close at hand?

title: Top Secret UFO Projects: Declassified
description:
Hacked and Leaked
In 1996, the Westall elementary school located in the Melbourne suburbs in Australia experienced one of the largest UFO sightings. It was also a textbook example of government agencies manipulating the public opinion, threatening witnesses, and confiscating evidence. Information regarding UFOs, whether directly or indirectly acquired, often ends in court. Americans Betty Cash and Vickie Landrum file a lawsuit against the army in 1980 for medical complications caused by witnessing a giant UFO. Meanwhile, the American Defense Ministry wishes to try Gary McKinnon – a hacker who broke their passwords and gained access to Pentagon and NASA computers. Did he find proof of alien civilizations? The leak of the century, however, is the 2002 “Admiral Wilson Leak.” It uncovers the methods behind classifying programs related to recovered extraterrestrial aircraft. Email correspondence between Tom DeLonge, a rocker, and John Podesta, a political advisor, by the non-profit company WikiLeaks in 2016 suggests that the desire to reveal information to the public can often come from the guardians of those very secrets.

title: Top Secret UFO Projects: Declassified
description:
Soviet Secrets
The key moment which determined the official Soviet approach to the UFO phenomenon was the Petrozavodsk incident of 1977. The extravagant performance of unknown objects in the skies above the city led to the creation of two special boards - scientific and military. Unidentified objects keep appearing both above nuclear installations and other areas of the Eastern Bloc. In 1987,  a military helicopter pursues an unknown object whose shape and flight capabilities fits the description of the "TIC-TAC" UFO above Czechoslovakia. An unprecedented incident also takes place in Soviet Dalnegorsk, where a crash of an unknown craft triggers what seems to be a massive search operation conducted by other alien objects. And what can be inferred from the interest of the Russian army in USOs - Unidentified submerged objects? Will the truth about UFOs come from the US, Russia, or another country altogether?

title: Top Secret UFO Projects: Declassified
description:
After Disclosure
Evidence of unknown flying objects controlled by extraordinarily advanced intelligence has been accompanying humans through their entire history. So called "Star People" appear in the cosmologies of many ancient cultures. What do we know about their potential intent? Where are they from, and why do they visit Earth? Possible answers might be found in the analysis of an incident that took place in the African city of Ruwa, where an unknown vehicle landed on the property of a small school and communicated telepathically with the local children. Is a hypothetical official contact with an advanced alien civilization a matter of hope or a threat?  The testimonies of people who have experienced close encounters of the third kind seem to suggest that our unknown visitors are not hostile. What will the world look like after their revelation, and what could possibly arise from the truth about the extraterrestrial technologies that are being researched? Based on his personal experience with UFOs, the author of this program Petr Vachler will provide his perspective on some of these questions.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
Inside Area 51
In 2013--after decades of secrecy, denials, and cover-ups--the CIA declassified documents that acknowledged the existence of a top-secret military research facility known as Area 51. But despite this disclosure, six years later in 2019, millions responded to an internet post advocating for them to storm the gates. Why does this Top-Secret location continue to draw so much attention--and suspicion? What really goes on within its heavily secured walls? Should we be reassured by its existence? Or fearful?

Or even an extraterrestrial presence on Earth right now? And if so, why is this happening now, what form might the announcement take, and what might happen in its aftermath?

title: In Search of Aliens
description:
The Hunt for Atlantis
Ever since Plato first wrote about the mysterious island of Atlantis, it has captured the imagination of adventurers and academics alike. Was Atlantis merely a myth, or could it have actually existed in the remote past? Did Atlantis just disappear as Plato described? And could it have been the home of an advanced civilization that created the human race? Ancient Astronaut Theorist Giorgio A. Tsoukalos explores the most recent discoveries related to the centuries-old story of Atlantis. By investigating a series of clues, Tsoukalos endeavors to narrow down the possible location of Atlantis. Could evidence be found in a strange egg-shaped stone in Portugal? What secrets can be uncovered on the island of Santorini, Greece? Could Atlantis have been an empire with a network that stretched around the world? Or was it something else entirely? Something that, perhaps, came from the stars?

title: Biz Kids
description:
Taking Charge of Your Financial Future
Join the Biz Kid$ as they set financial goals, and then make a plan to get there.  Learn about opportunity costs and how achieving your goals requires a little sacrifice.  Follow along as a Biz Kid sets up his first savings account. Meet an entrepreneur who turned jewelry into a dirt bike, and another who turned goat's milk into profitable soap.

title: Biz Kids
description:
What Is It
You’ll see that a successful business supplies goods or services and makes profit when it earns more money than it spends. Meet the junior high school boy who makes healthy dog biscuits, the high school twins with a cake decorating company, and the college student who made thousands from selling DVDs on eBay.

title: Missing: Cold Cases
description:
Missing: Cold Case 259
Profiling the cold cases of missing children; Internet safety tips; Advice for children and teens about emergency contacts and safety skills.

title: Missing: Cold Cases
description:
Missing: Cold Case 260
Profiling the cold cases of missing children; Internet safety tips; Advice for children and teens about emergency contacts and safety skills.

title: In Search of Aliens
description:
Nazi Time Travelers
At the height of World War II, the Nazis engaged their top scientists to develop "wonder weapons"--weapons that were so scientifically advanced they could have turned the tide of the war against the Allies. According to testimony, one of the top-secret projects was code-named "Die Glocke." Die Glocke was believed to be a bell-shaped time travel device that could soar through the sky and eventually reach the speed of light and beyond. Did Die Glocke actually exist? And if so, could it have been based on alien technology? Theorist Giorgio A. Tsoukalos travels from Poland to Pennsylvania on the trail of the Nazis' "wonder weapon." Did the Nazis find advanced knowledge in ancient texts that enabled them to develop anti-gravity technology? And was the construction of a time travel device made possible by reverse-engineering extraterrestrial technology?

title: In Search Of
description:
Aliens
Host Zach Quinto sets out to discover whether Aliens exist and what evidence we have to prove it. He meets with several people who say they have encountered extraterrestrial life.

title: In Search Of
description:
UFOs
Are we alone in the universe? With every new UFO sighting, we ask this age-old question. To find out, we'll hunt for eyewitnesses to large-scale otherworldly encounters and pore through declassified government data on UFOs in our airspace.

title: Story Feature
description:
UFOs: Top Secret Alien Files
For everyday heroes in law enforcement and the military, their mission to serve and protect is put to the ultimate test when they come face to face with dangerous UFOs. Through dramatic reenactments of actual UFO classified files and expert interviews, this special explores the lengths that people on the front lines will go to keep civilians safe from extraterrestrial encounters.

title: In Search of Aliens
description:
The Mystery of the Cyclops
The mysterious Mediterranean island of Malta lies south of Sicily and is home to megalithic structures built by a mysterious prehistoric society. According to scholars, the massive blocks even pre-date the Great Pyramid of Giza. Just who were the people that built these sophisticated structures? Local folklore describes Malta as being the home of giants and the legendary one-eyed creature known as Cyclops. Could these stories be true--or could they offer clues to an extraterrestrial connection? Ancient Astronaut theorist Giorgio Tsoukalos investigates Matla's giant stone structures, unexplained rock carvings and mysterious elongated skulls. Could these strange antiquities be connected--and might they prove that there was a highly advanced civilization on Malta in the remote past--one that was perhaps in contact with ancient astronauts?

title: In Search of Aliens
description:
The Roswell Rock
A mysterious rock bearing a cryptic design was discovered in Roswell, New Mexico in 2004. Now coined "The Roswell Rock," this piece of stone is unusually smooth and possesses unique magnetic properties. Even more intriguing is that the motif on the rock--a sequence of triangles and crescents--is an exact match to a crop circle found in England nearly two decades ago. Ancient Astronaut Theorist Giorgio Tsoukalos sets out to determine the origin of this intriguing stone. Through a series of experiments Tsoukalos unveils whether the Roswell Rock is merely a man-made fabrication or something much more. How could the precise design have been created without leaving evidence of altering the stone? Why does this small rock react to magnets? And most baffling of all--why does the design match a crop circle that appeared more than 4,000 miles away from the Nevada desert?

title: Conquest
description:
Stone Age Weapons
Actor and fight master Peter Woodward introduces us to Stone-Age weapons.

title: Conquest
description:
Knives and Daggers
Knives were as essential to the Stone Age as they are to modern Special Forces.

title: Conquest
description:
Unarmed Combat
The team follows wrestling techniques painted on the walls of Egyptian tombs.

title: Conquest
description:
Weapons of the Gladiators
The ancient world boasted many special weapons, some of which became almost ritualized.

title: Conquest
description:
Secret Weapons of the Ninja
Host Peter Woodward delves into the history of Japan's Ninja.

title: Conquest
description:
The Medieval Broadsword
The medieval symbol of power, religion, and authority, the broadsword's final mold resulted from thousands of years of technological advances.

title: Conquest
description:
The Duel
With actor and fight master Peter Woodward as guide, we see how the duel developed from trial by combat. The duel of honor was always the gentleman's recourse against slander and insult--in the 16th century, the duel had become epidemic.

title: Conquest
description:
Pirate Weapons
Peter Woodward sweeps over the sea in the guise of a 17th-century Caribbean pirate, teaching the Conquest Team the dos and don'ts of close-quarter pirate warfare.

title: Conquest
description:
Early Firearms
You slam a lit match into a pan of gunpowder, six inches from your face, sending a lead ball with the diameter of a quarter hurtling toward your enemy--while he fires back at you! Engage in an exploration of early firearms.

title: Conquest
description:
Weapons of Native Americans
Examining the weapons and warfare of the North American Plains Indians.

title: Conquest
description:
Weapons of the Civil War
Host Peter Woodward leads a team of rookies in mastery of the Civil War arsenal.

title: Conquest
description:
Trench Warfare
Trench warfare was a hellish nightmare that claimed millions of lives during World War I. But some people did survive the trenches. Host Peter Woodward leads the Conquest Team into the filth and horror of trench warfare, teaching them the skills they need to come out alive!

title: Conquest
description:
American Soldiers of WWII
Host Peter Woodward and the Conquest Team examine the weapons and tactics of U.S. soldiers in WWII.

title: Conquest
description:
Air Combat
Though the newest form of personal warfare is less than a century old, the basics of air combat have changed little since the first soldiers of the sky soared through the air in WWI. Actor and fight master Peter Woodward trains as a fighter pilot.

title: Conquest
description:
Urban Ops
Peter Woodward and his team learn what it takes to be in a police SWAT team.

title: Conquest
description:
Demolition Derby
Actor and fight master Peter Woodward trains for the Orange County Fair's Demolition Derby, where he contends with the craziest drivers in California, all competing to have the last car running--and to take home $2,000 in prize money!

title: Hell's Battlefield
description:
Kursk
In the summer of 1943, one of the greatest clashes of WWII took place on the Eastern Front--the Battle of Kursk. Vast in scale and terrible in intensity, German and Russian armies, millions strong on each side, engaged in a fierce attack.

title: Hell's Battlefield
description:
The Bulge: The First 15 Days
In December 1944, Hitler prepared a strike force to split the Allies, hoping to destroy all Allied forces north of the Antwerp-Brussels-Bastogne line.

title: Story Feature
description:
Winter Warriors
Traces the story of the U.S. Army's legendary 10th Mountain Division. They were formed after WWII began, specifically to fight in high, rugged mountain conditions.
